Criminal case (CRIMINAL_CASE) is CLOSED as of 2009-06-29 sentencing. SIPA liquidation / DOJ Victim Fund recovery (SIPA_LIQUIDATION, DOJ_VICTIM_FUND) are ONGOING/POST_CONVICTION_CONTEXT as of the 2026-02-27 cutoff and must carry independent ProceedingStatus values.

Madoff held private securities-industry and SRO roles (NASD/NASDAQ) and SEC advisory-committee participation; never a government official — do not characterize institutional access as bribery, conspiracy, or government employment absent a cited source.
